pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular dark-brown patches with varied edge angularity; some edges appear smooth while others exhibit sharp, jagged pixel-level protrusions. Patches on the central flank occupy significantly more spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches near the ventral line and shoulder transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous lattice with junction nodes typically intersecting three to four distinct pathways. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, creating a well-defined topological graph between the dark tesserae.
